hypotheses.claim: Only the hard-coded validator service list is wrong.
evidence_for: The causal failure was validator container-missing for Atlas after all prior deploy steps passed.
evidence_against: Deploy, health, rollback, and active reconciliation also had generation-incomplete lifecycle behavior.
hypotheses.cheapest_falsifier: Compare manifest, render, start, inspect, health, and rollback sets for both generations.
hypotheses.blast_radius_if_wrong: A one-line exception would allow activation without starting or safely removing Atlas.

hypotheses.claim: Dashboard substitution is semantically invalid beyond rendering.
evidence_for: Dashboard uses a Streamlit entrypoint; Atlas requires /usr/local/bin/atlas-observer.
evidence_against: The substitution can permit legacy Compose rendering when topology structurally prevents start.
hypotheses.cheapest_falsifier: Compare Dockerfile entrypoints and require Atlas binary identity in health validation.
hypotheses.blast_radius_if_wrong: A Dashboard container could be mislabeled as Atlas.

hypotheses.claim: Deploy lifecycle is correct for seven images but incomplete for eight images.
evidence_for: The old start list omitted Atlas for every generation.

hypotheses.claim: Rollback cannot safely remove Atlas when the target generation omits it.
